headline: Waist-high ESE at the right angle, clean and small — a dawn log session.
today: Prime ESE angle but only knee-to-waist and short-to-medium period, so nobody's getting shacked. Good news is NNW offshore holds all day and never gets above 10, so it's glassy from dawn through the evening high. Bring the log or a longer groveler, work the incoming push toward the 3pm high, and keep expectations low. Best window is honestly whenever you can get in — it's clean start to finish.

daysToWatch.note: Small ESE at prime angle with light-to-offshore N wind all day and glassy 3mph evening. Same log-it-or-skip-it size, but clean.
More size on tap (2-3ft) but it's short-period S at a marginal angle with 15-17mph cross wind. Junky — skip unless you're desperate.
